detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You're invited to the Tea Garden! Fill your Cabins with hedge mazes, gazebos, and Tea Garden decos. Dress up yourself and your Sanrio friends in Regency glamour and discover the secrets in new Merry Meadows quests. Unlock new recipes, food stations, and more!

  • 15 New clothing items with 300+ variants: Bonnets, bows, and full regency finery

  • 2 New Food Stations: the Teapot and the Tiered Tray

  • 38 New recipes: tea, scones and sandwiches galore

  • 15+ New Narrative Quests in the Merry Meadows: Help Hello Kitty, My Melody, Pochacco, Kuromi, Chococat, and more prepare for the Tea Garden Ball

  • New Furniture & Decor Set: Transform your cabins into Tea Gardens of your very own!

  • 30+ NPC outfits: Dress your Friends and Visitors in fancy finery
